card.name: First item of a pair before 'and'
card.fires_on: The first member of a two-part list or pairing, right before 'and' or 'of', where a second item is expected (e.g. 'carbohydrates' before 'and protein', 'adults' before 'and adolescents').

modes.label: Nutrient comparisons
modes.description: Carbohydrates or protein in a comparison of calories per gram, where the next word is 'and'.
modes.example: Fats provide 9 calories per gram compared to 4 calories per gram for<< carbohydrates>> and protein.

modes.label: Paired patient groups or drugs
modes.description: A linking word right after the first of two groups or drugs, in dosing text.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage Adults<< and>> Adolescents 12 years of age

card.writes: It pushes words like 'either' and 'both' that introduce a pair of options.
card.plain: It lights up when the first of two paired items has just been named and the second is about to follow.
